an6.28:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye.
an6.28:1.2: Atha kho tesaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāle sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi
an6.28:1.3: ‘ko no kho āvuso samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti? 2.
an6.28:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etad avoca
an6.28:2.2: ‘yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti. 3.
an6.28:3.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca
an6.28:3.2: ‘na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:3.3: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, cārittakilamatho pi 'ssa, tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti, bhattakilamatho pi 'ssa, tasmiṃ samaye appaṭippassaddho hoti.
an6.28:3.4: Tasmā so asamayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:3.5: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti. 4.
an6.28:4.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca
an6.28:4.2: ‘na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:4.3: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito vihārapacchāyāyaṃ nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, yad ev'assa divā samādhinimittaṃ manasikataṃ hoti, tad ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye samudācarati.
an6.28:4.4: Tasmā so asamayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:4.5: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti. 5.
an6.28:5.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca
an6.28:5.2: ‘na kho āvuso so samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:5.3: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, ojaṭṭhāyi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye kāyo hoti, phāsu 'ssa hoti buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ.
an6.28:5.4: Tasmā so asamayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti. 6.
an6.28:6.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Mahākaccāno there bhikkhū etad avoca:--
an6.28:6.2: Sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
an6.28:6.3: cha yime bhikkhu samayā manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:7.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāti, tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo
an6.28:7.3: ‘ahaṃ kho āvuso kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharāmi kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na ppajānāmi,
an6.28:7.4: sādhu vata me āyasmā kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desetū' ti,
an6.28:7.5: tassa manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu kāmarāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an6.28:7.6: Ayaṃ bhikkhu paṭhamo samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. 8.
an6.28:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu vyāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati . . . pe . . .
an6.28:12.1: yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, taṃ nimittaṃ na jānāti na passati, tasmiṃ samaye manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu upasaṅkamitvā evam assa vacanīyo
an6.28:12.2: ‘ahaṃ kho āvuso yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti, taṃ nimittaṃ na jānāmi na passāmi,
an6.28:12.3: sādhu vata me āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ desetū' ti,
an6.28:12.4: tassa manobhāvanīyo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayāya dhammaṃ deseti.
an6.28:12.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhu chaṭṭho samayo manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
an6.28:13.1: Sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
an6.28:13.2: ime kho bhikkhu cha samayā manobhāvanīyassa bhikkhuno dassanāya upasaṅkamitun
